scenes.title: DISTINCT
scenes.narration: DISTINCT removes duplicate rows from your results, giving you a clean list of unique values.

scenes.title: Why DISTINCT matters
bullets: Applies across all selected columns together
scenes.narration: DISTINCT keeps only one copy of each repeated row so your output has no duplicates. It considers all selected columns together, meaning uniqueness is judged on the full combination. This makes it perfect for pulling a clean list of unique categories or values.

scenes.title: Listing unique values
scenes.narration: Here DISTINCT scans the country column and returns each value only once. Even if thousands of customers share the same country, you get a single row per country. The result is a compact list of every unique country represented.

scenes.title: How DISTINCT works
scenes.narration: The engine first collects the rows chosen by your SELECT list. It then compares the combination of selected columns across rows. Any exact duplicates are dropped, leaving only the unique set behind.

scenes.text: Use DISTINCT when you need a deduplicated view, but remember it evaluates all selected columns as a unit.
scenes.narration: Reach for DISTINCT to deduplicate results, keeping in mind that uniqueness is measured across every column you select.
